protocol.distance: Euclidean on reference-standardized nonconstant features; no whitening
protocol.resampling: nested samples without replacement; repeat ranges are not confidence intervals
protocol.synthetic_selection: complete cases, equal retained counts; input failures separately reported
protocol.length_matching: source corpora matched in the original pilot; random subsets not individually rematched
protocol.grid: fixed all-real PCA, bins 15/30/45, 16 lattice phases, three bound populations
protocol.controls: illustrative base-LOO-q90 radius with 32 pairs, not held-out population calibration
